framing: method evaluation using a narrow task as instrument; not circuit discovery

freeze.frozen_from: post-query sweep on dev: Falcon 552322 and TinkerCliffs 7307558 (commit 7adaad1). Layer rule = pre-registered argmax of mean paired intermediate margin on dev; both clusters selected identical layers at every position carrying signal.

position_anchors.relcomp: token immediately preceding the final '?' -- completes the relation (dev T1: ' lives')
position_anchors.prequery: last token of the facts block -- REFERENCE ONLY, binding undetermined here
position_anchors.final: last prompt token -- REFERENCE ONLY, output-contaminated (38/40 dev generations name the intermediate)

freeze.why_anchors_not_indices: held-out uses templates T1-T6 of varying length; a frozen token index would silently misalign across templates

layers.jlens_random_transport: evaluated at the jlens layers -- the control shares the treatment's frozen settings

freeze.arm3: difference-in-means, fit on ALL dev records, applied unchanged to held-out (the section-2.5 promise)
freeze.heldout_contact_before_freeze: _meta header, n_records=160, n_pairs=40, template_id set T1..T6 only; no prompts, entities or answers
freeze.failure_condition: held-out frac at BOTH primary positions at or near its label-permutation control => the sweep result was forking paths; that outcome is the finding and is reported as such

protocol.lr: sklearn LogisticRegression(C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter=500, tol=1e-3), StandardScaler fit on the training fold
protocol.dim: supervised_reference.fit_centroids / margin_of on the same fold
